name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii
summary: Soviet and Russian chemist, professor, and organizer of the scientific school of Chemistry of highly organized substances.

name: Stanislav Ivanovich Kol'tsov
summary: Soviet and Russian chemist, graduate student of Aleskovskii, and co-inventor of the Molecular Layering method.

name: Anatolii A. Malygin
summary: Russian chemist, professor, and student of Aleskovskii who continued ML research.

name: Victor E. Drozd
summary: Russian physicist and chemist, student of Aleskovskii, developer of vacuum ML equipment.

name: T. Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist, inventor of Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE).

name: N. A. Kosygin
summary: Prime Minister of the USSR who showed interest in ML technology.

name: Leningrad Technological Institute by Lensovet
summary: Educational chemical engineering institute in Russia where Aleskovskii studied and worked.

name: Leningrad State University
summary: University where Aleskovskii served as rector and founded a department.

name: Naval Research Institute
summary: Research institute in Leningrad where Aleskovskii worked after graduation.

name: Academy of Sciences of the USSR
summary: National academy of sciences of the Soviet Union.

name: Supreme Soviet of the Russian Federation
summary: Legislative body of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic.

name: Mary
summary: City in Turkmenistan where Aleskovskii was born.

name: Leningrad
summary: City in Russia where Aleskovskii studied and worked for most of his life.

name: Molecular Layering
summary: Gas-phase layer by layer deposition technology developed in the Soviet Union.

summary: Theoretical concept proposed by Aleskovskii regarding the chemical structure of solids.

name: Atomic Layer Epitaxy
